user.title: T-Embed Remote
user.description: Adds the T-Embed Remote. There is nothing to fill in. Afterwards open the app on the remote to pair it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: T-Embed Remote is already set up.

init.title: T-Embed Remote
init.description: Favourites, groups, rooms and pairing are easier on the T-Embed page in the sidebar.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Pick which label marks your favourites and which hides things from the remote. Add these labels to lights and switches anywhere in Home Assistant. Rooms come from your areas.

data_description.favourites_label: Anything with this label shows in Favourites at the top. New labels are made under Settings, Areas, labels and zones.
data_description.hide_label: Anything with this label never appears on the remote.
data_description.hidden_areas: These rooms will not appear on the remote at all.
data_description.allow_remote: Off by default. Leave it off unless the remote has to reach Home Assistant from another network; a key copied off a lost SD card then works from anywhere.

pairing.title: Enter pairing code
pairing.description: Type the six digit code shown on the remote.

devices.title: Paired devices
devices.description: Pick a remote to remove it. It stops working straight away and will ask to pair again.

error.invalid_code: That code is not correct. Try again.
error.unknown_device: That remote is no longer paired.

abort.no_pending: No remote is waiting to pair. Open the app on the remote first, it will show a code.
abort.pairing_complete: Paired. The remote will load your rooms in a couple of seconds.
abort.pairing_expired: That code has expired. The remote will show a new one, enter that instead.
